correctness.rationale: Exact tail-sum identity, κ-power survival expansion with summable remainders, fixed-s Euler–Maclaurin estimate and full p=2 algebra prove all fixed-parameter cases. At the admissible equality curve the x^-1 coefficient vanishes while the cubic coefficient (1-4c²)/60 is strictly negative. Numerical replays of the extracted standalone script support, but do not replace, the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact residual-life diagnostic is a natural invariant for discrete Pareto exceedance models; the theorem identifies a sharp ξ=1/2 transition between body-carrier and lattice-dominated curvature, a parameter-dependent sign reversal and a nontrivial higher-order cancellation curve. These have a concrete bearing on interpreting integer mean-excess plots, without assuming or claiming a downstream estimation theorem.
